text: Adjust, clean, or repair products or processing equipment to correct defects found during inspections.
Train users on the use and function of computer programs.
Direct or support quality improvement projects or safety programs.
Pack and store materials and products.
Prepare ordinances, resolutions, or proclamations so that they can be executed, recorded, archived, or distributed.
Develop individual treatment plans and strategies.
Provide assistance in balancing books, tracking, monitoring, or projecting a unit's budget needs, and in developing unit policies and procedures.
Design custom clothing and accessories for individuals, retailers, or theatrical, television, or film productions.
Analyze compensation policies, government regulations, and prevailing wage rates to develop competitive compensation plan.
Arrange for ships to be fueled, restocked with supplies, or repaired.
Train new employees to control and suppress fires.
Monitor, evaluate, or record training activities or program effectiveness.
Make tentative diagnoses and decisions about management and treatment of patients.
Prepare drafts of amendments, government policies, laws, rules, regulations, budgets, programs and procedures.
Negotiate and authorize purchase, sale, exchange, or loan of collections.
Complete administrative responsibilities, such as coordinating paperwork, scheduling case management activities, or writing lesson plans.
Manage and maintain executives' schedules.
Meet with department heads, managers, supervisors, vendors, and others, to solicit cooperation and resolve problems.
Position instructions and comments onto drawings.
Plan and prepare advertising and promotional material to increase sales of products or services, working with customers, company officials, sales departments, and advertising agencies.
Prepare reports, including assignment of company funds or recording of department revenues.
Provide feedback to production staff regarding technical game qualities or adherence to original design.
Analyze financial activities of establishments or departments and provide input into budget planning and preparation processes.

Perform minor plumbing, welding, or concrete mixing work.

Research legal issues and write opinions on the issues.

Meet with other professionals to discuss individual students' needs and progress.

Write press releases or other media communications to promote clients.
Attend meetings to record minutes.
Direct the hiring, training, or performance evaluations of marketing or sales staff and oversee their daily activities.

Receive payment or obtain credit authorization.
Collect and test samples of cleaning solutions or vapors.
Select and edit documents for publication and display, applying knowledge of subject, literary expression, and presentation techniques.
